POCKET.MapFree.Name: Use map-free mode on this browser
POCKET.MapFree.Hint: Keeps Foundry's Scene canvas disabled on this browser while using Pocket Chronicle. Changing this requires a reload.
POCKET.RelayUrl.Name: Pocket Chronicle app address
POCKET.RelayUrl.Hint: Use the base HTTPS address of your Pocket Chronicle app. A pasted /mobile.html phone-page address is removed automatically.
POCKET.CampaignId.Name: Campaign ID
POCKET.CampaignId.Hint: The campaign ID created when this campaign was provisioned.
POCKET.CampaignCode.Name: Permanent six-character Campaign code
POCKET.CampaignCode.Hint: Choose exactly six letters or numbers. O and 0 are treated alike; I, L, and 1 are treated alike. Players enter this code with the Campaign ID.
POCKET.BridgeKey.Name: Private bridge key
POCKET.BridgeKey.Hint: Keep this secret. Players never need this key.
POCKET.PollMs.Name: Action check interval
POCKET.PollMs.Hint: How often an Active World checks for phone actions. Fifteen seconds is recommended; Sleeping worlds make no checks.
